notes:
What's new in 0.23.2

• Settings > Playback > Pick a source for me: Play chooses a source once 1, 3, 5, 10 or 20 are found, or turn it Off to always choose from the list yourself. With fewer than your number, the list opens for you to pick.
• The player's controls and timeline come up every time you press OK.
• Back while watching goes to Choose Source, so you can try another source.
• Settings > Playback > Audio language: plays your language's audio whenever the file has it.
